name: Avoid Brainrot Snipers
desc:
Welcome to Avoid Brainrot Snipers!

Dive to protection! There are snipers! 🏃
If you go out at the wrong time, you will get one shot! ⏳
Run and grab brainrots and bring them back⚡
Upgrade Brainrots to boost your earnings! 💸
Upgrade your base to unlock slots to place even more Brainrots! 🏗️

Like the game and join the group 👍
